description: Read the owner's accounting connection/setup state, selected organization/company/business, rollout state and one connect/reconnect setupUrl. Pass an existing reportId to open that exact report's provider setup control; otherwise general Reports setup. Never posts data. Agent posting: Zoho Books only; QuickBooks Online, Xero, Wave and FreeAgent (beta) are connection/status only (writesAuthorized=false).

provider.description: Accounting destination provider. QuickBooks Online, Xero, Wave, FreeAgent (beta), or Zoho Books.

reportId.description: Optional existing ExpenseBot report ID. When supplied, setupUrl opens this exact report and highlights the selected accounting provider's setup control.

name: get_accounting_integration_status
